name: Browser
purpose: displays web pages
note: Many people set a search engine as their browser's home page, which is why the two seem to be one thing

name: Search engine
purpose: keeps an index of web pages and finds pages in it — and is itself a website
note: It is reached THROUGH a browser, the way a shop is reached through a door

name: Spider
purpose: walks web pages and builds the index a search engine keeps
note: Nobody uses a spider directly; it works for the search engine that owns it

name: Operating system
purpose: runs a device and the programs on it

name: Device
purpose: brings processor, memory and screen together into one machine you hold or sit in front of

name: Word processor
purpose: writes and formats documents that are meant to be read as pages
note: Confused with the office suite it usually arrives in

name: Spreadsheet
purpose: holds numbers in a grid and calculates with them
note: The second thing in nearly every office suite, and the reason the suite is not a word processor

name: Office suite
purpose: bundles several programs that are sold and installed as one — typically a word processor, a spreadsheet and a presentation program
note: The whole point of having this type: a suite is not any of the things inside it, and that is what makes „ist MS-Office ein Textprogramm?“ a real question

name: Messenger
purpose: carries messages between people who each have it installed
note: Three of them in this inventory from three different makers — a good place to see that the maker is not the thing

name: Processor
purpose: carries out the steps a program is made of — the part that actually computes
note: Named as if it were the whole machine: „ein schneller Rechner“ usually means this one part

name: Working memory
purpose: holds what is being worked on right now, and is empty again after the device is switched off
note: Half of the commonest confusion in this whole inventory — both it and the storage are called „Speicher“ in German

name: Storage medium
purpose: keeps files so they are still there after the device has been switched off
note: The other half: „mein Speicher ist voll“ is nearly always this one, and „der Rechner ist langsam“ nearly always the other

name: Screen
purpose: shows what the device puts out, and takes the touches on it as input
note: On a phone it is also the keyboard, which is why a broken one takes the whole device with it

name: Battery
purpose: stores electricity so the device runs without a cable
note: The one part that wears out by being used normally, which no other part in this list does

name: Online encyclopedia
purpose: collects knowledge in articles that its readers write and correct themselves
note: A website, not a program — and therefore the counterpart to the search engine: one FINDS pages, this one IS a page

name: Mail client
purpose: fetches your mail from a server and shows it, and sends what you write
note: On a phone it is usually the one the maker of the phone put there

name: AI assistant
purpose: answers in sentences, because it was trained on an enormous amount of text
note: The newest kind here, and the one where maker and product are least alike: ChatGPT is not OpenAI and Claude is not Anthropic

name: Map service
purpose: shows where things are and how to get from one to the other
note: Deliberately without a Wikipedia article: „Geodienst" is the data behind a map, not the app one opens, and a reference that is merely close is worse than none

name: Video platform
purpose: keeps videos that anyone may upload and anyone may watch

name: App store
purpose: is where the programs on a phone come from, and where they are kept up to date
note: Each phone maker has one, and it is one of the few kinds where the name of the thing barely differs from the name of the kind

name: Cloud storage
purpose: keeps files on somebody else’s computer so every device of yours can reach them

name: Media player
purpose: plays a sound or a video file, whatever it was recorded with

name: File manager
purpose: shows what is on a device as folders and files, and lets you move, copy and delete them
note: The one program almost nobody names, because on every system it is simply „the window that opens“

name: Document viewer
purpose: opens a document and shows it without being able to change it
note: Asked for as „ODF-Viewer“ or „PDF-Viewer“ — but the format is not the kind: one viewer opens several formats, which is what FileFormat is in the model for

name: Barcode scanner
purpose: reads the stripes or squares on a label and turns them back into the number or address they stand for
note: On a phone this is the camera, which is why most people have never installed one and still use one weekly

name: Network storage
purpose: keeps files on a box of its own in the house, reachable from every device on the network
note: Known by its abbreviation NAS. The bridge between the two kinds of storage a person knows: it is as reachable as a cloud drive and as local as a disk — the own cloud in the hallway
